units.source_text: 夕雾大概想乘此机会向玉鬘表明心愫，拿了一枝很美丽的兰草。

en.t: Yugiri probably meant to use this chance to reveal his feelings to Tamakazura, and he took up a very beautiful spray of orchid grass.

units.source_text: 从帘子边上塞进帘内去，对玉鬘说道：

en.t: He slipped it inside through the edge of the curtain and said to Tamakazura:
You too have a bond that lets you look upon this flower.

units.source_text: 他不立刻把花放下，只管拿在手里。

en.t: He did not set the flower down at once, but simply kept holding it in his hand.

units.source_text: 玉鬘仓促之间不曾注意到，伸手去拿花，夕雾便拉住了她的衣袖，扯动一下，赠诗云：

en.t: Tamakazura, flustered, did not notice; when she reached out to take the flower, Yugiri caught hold of her sleeve, tugged it lightly, and offered this poem:
